title: completion-gate evidence block
description: Shape of the fenced ```evidence JSON block completion-gate.sh validates (Level 1) before checking provenance (Level 2). Documentation artifact for humans/tests — completion-gate.sh itself validates inline with jq, not by loading this file.

claim.description: What is being claimed as done/fixed/verified.

type.description: What kind of artifact `ref` names, which determines the Level 2 provenance check.

ref.description: The command run, test name, commit sha, URL, or file path this claim points at.

scope.description: Whether the evidence proves the logic (unit) or the deployed/live effect (live).

result.description: Optional short summary of the observed outcome.
